description: This is a black, cylindrical flashlight with a textured grip. It features a prominent orange switch or button on the side, designed for easy activation. The top of the flashlight has a wide, ribbed head, suggesting a powerful beam projection. The body of the flashlight is segmented with horizontal ridges, enhancing grip and durability. Near the base, there is a small label with text, indicating the brand 'Akari' and a model number. The overall design is functional and robust, suitable for outdoor use or emergency situations. The flashlight stands upright on a flat base.
